## API de MiniMax H3 Max Turbo {#minimax-h3-max-turbo-api}

MiniMax H3 Max Turbo es un modelo de texto a video e imagen a video de MiniMax, disponible en la Venice API como `minimax-h3-max-turbo-text-to-video`. Se ejecuta de forma privada, sin retención de datos.

### Precios de la API de MiniMax H3 Max Turbo {#minimax-h3-max-turbo-api-pricing}

| ID del modelo | Variante | Privacidad | Precio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minimax-h3-max-turbo-text-to-video` | Texto a video | Private | desde $0.02 / s |
| `minimax-h3-max-turbo-image-to-video` | Imagen a video | Private | desde $0.02 / s |

### Cómo usar la API de MiniMax H3 Max Turbo {#how-to-use-the-minimax-h3-max-turbo-api}

Envía solicitudes a `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` con `"model": "minimax-h3-max-turbo-text-to-video"` y tu clave de API.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-h3-max-turbo-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "resolution": "480P",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "minimax-h3-max-turbo-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
